ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:1 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels; fluke is predominantly dark with high-intensity clusters isolated to distal extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation is localized at the distal tips of both lobes. The interior surface is a contiguous low-intensity black region, punctuated by discrete circular high-intensity spots in the mid-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations along the continuous trailing edge; significant irregular peaks (sawtooth pattern) concentrated on the outer 40% of each lobe's width.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme jaggedness of the trailing edge topography creates a unique sawtooth profile that distinguishes this specimen from those with smoother lobe boundaries.
